subject: Interim sprint stipend appeal — pending invoice clearance
content:
From: Clara Jensen <clara@lumatech.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Porter <jake.porter@lumatech.ai>, procurement@lumatech.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO in review (need short buffer?)

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited to run the end-to-end tests next week. Our procurement team has put the PO through an additional validation step and it looks like clearance will slip past our original start date.

Is there any way Redwood can provide a small interim token stipend or temporary access to keep the sandbox live for another 7 days while procurement wraps up? Were not looking for a major concession — just enough to run the automated scenarios to preserve momentum.

I attached the draft PO (Lumatech_PO_Draft.pdf) and a quick usage snapshot from our trial so you can see the expected run.

Appreciate any flexibility here.

Best,
Clara Jensen
R&D Lead, Lumatech

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@lumatech.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO in review (need short buffer?)

Hi Clara,

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft. I reviewed the usage summary and it looks within expected bounds. We can absolutely help avoid a hard stop.

Quick proposal: we can provision a 7-day micro-stipend that covers the sandbox capacity youre using (up to 200k tokens / test runs) while procurement completes the signoff. If procurement needs longer, well revisit — but this should buy your engineers the time to finish the automated runs.

Before I approve, two items I need:
- Confirmation of the PO approver contact and the expected clearance date (weve found even an estimated date helps).
- A signed acknowledgement (simple email reply is fine) stating the team will not exceed the described test scope — this is just to keep the pilot contained.

Ill loop Sean and Camila for quick operational follow-up.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Clara Jensen <clara@lumatech.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, procurement@lumatech.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — PO in review (need short buffer?)

Clara / Mina —

I can waive the onboarding hold and activate a 7-day stipend immediately once we have the single confirmation e-mail from Lumatech procurement that the PO is under final review and the expected clearance date (we dont need the final PO to grant the brief buffer).

Camila, can you stand up the stipend and send a usage cap summary to Clara?

Sean Gallagher
Director, Growth | Redwood Inference

---
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Jensen <clara@lumatech.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0000
Subject: RE: Pilot onboarding — PO in review (need short buffer?)

Thanks, Clara — we got the confirmation from Jake (procurement@lumatech.ai) this morning that the PO is in final approval and expects to clear by 2027-07-10.

Per Mina/Sean, Ive provisioned the 7-day micro-stipend effective immediately. Limits: 200k tokens total, API access limited to the sandbox project id youve been using. Ive attached a short CSV with your current trial usage for tracking (trial-usage-summary.csv).

If you hit the cap early, reply to this thread and we can evaluate extension on a case-by-case basis.

Notes / Attachments:
- Lumatech_PO_Draft.pdf (from Clara)
- trial-usage-summary.csv (provisioning snapshot)

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
